description: Figure 3 is a bar chart titled "Results of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev," displaying execution accuracy for two modules, NatSQL (light blue) and TA-SQL (dark blue), across four difficulty levels: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis, labeled "Execution Accuracy," ranges from 20 to 60 with tick marks at intervals of 10, indicating a linear scale. The horizontal axis lists the four difficulty categories in order from left to right. For the Simple category, NatSQL achieves an accuracy of 60.21 and TA-SQL achieves 63.14. For the Moderate category, NatSQL scores 39.64 and TA-SQL scores 48.60. For the Challenging category, NatSQL scores 32.32 and TA-SQL scores 36.11. For the Total category, NatSQL scores 51.35 and TA-SQL scores 56.19. The bars are grouped by difficulty level, with the NatSQL bar appearing to the left of the TA-SQL bar in each group. The chart does not indicate any sorting of bars or visual emphasis such as shading or bolding.
